schedules.name: Daily Codebase Review
schedules.description: Taxonomy analyzes codebase structure and creates summary suggestion for human review

tasks.description: [WHAT] Analyze codebase and create summary suggestion [CONTEXT] Scan all files for: file sizes (>400 lines warn, logic files >1500 action), function lengths (>50 lines), duplicate code (>15 lines), naming inconsistencies, dead code, missing types [OUTPUT] Create ONE suggestion using create_suggestion tool with: title 'Daily Codebase Review - {date}', content summarizing top 5-10 issues with file:line references grouped by priority, category 'codebase' [CONSTRAINTS] Single summary suggestion only, prioritize by impact, include exact file paths and line numbers for each issue

schedules.name: Git Auto-Commit
schedules.description: Automatically commit and push all changes to git with auto-generated commit message
